usedFor: Qminder manages your visitor queue, and Documint produces documents when “visitor checks in” runs “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “visitor checks in” in Qminder, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A visitor’s check-in fills a Documint template, so a form or slip is ready as they arrive.

watchOut: “Add visitor to queue” and “visitor checks in” are different triggers, so pick one to avoid two documents.
